description: 한국재정정보원_재정통계BRIEF_통신 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국재정정보원. 2013년부터 2022년까지 통신 분야 시계열 자료 2021년까지는 결산, 2022년은 2차 추가경정예산 기준으로 작성 수치가 기본단위보다 적거나 수치가 없을 경우 0으로 표시 우정사업행정지원. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국재정정보원. Its tags are 통신분야, 분야별 재정지출, 재정통계, 디지털예산회계시스템, 시계열. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-07-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
